lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I heard you've been helping Crow

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: cope with the Daily Ark terrorist attack?
Yeah, that's right.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Did you see that video that came out a little while ago?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: "Terrorist Attack at Daily Ark (Shocking Footage)"
Yeah, I did.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Good, then I can get right to the point.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: We took the shooter into custody yesterday.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Looks like he'd been in regular contact with Crow

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: since about a year ago.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: He won't say what the two of them talked about, though.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: But judging from Crow's track record...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: It's certainly possible that she...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: that she pushed this guy into committing the crime.
That's still just a theory at this point.
That's pretty suspicious.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Oh, we're aware of that, of course.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Of course, that alone isn't enough to make her a suspect.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: As you know,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Crow has quite a record, even from back when she was human.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: And this time, she just happened to be caught on camera at the scene of the crime too.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: But that's not somewhere Crow usually operates.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Everyone at the station is pretty suspicious about it.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I figured you should at least know what's going on, so I thought I'd give you a heads-up, Commander.
Got it.
